summary: In AAP 2.5+, controller endpoints move from /api/v2/ to /api/controller/v2/, hub from /api/automation-hub to /api/galaxy/v1, with new /api/gateway/v1/ and /api/eda/v1/; tokens, organizations and teams move to /api/gateway/v1/ and the old controller endpoints are deprecated but still work in 2.6.
questions: What is the new API path for automation controller in AAP 2.6?
Where did /api/v2/o tokens move in AAP 2.6?
What is the automation hub API path in 2.6?

answer_card.title: API path changes in 2.5+
answer_card.answer_md:
| Component | 2.4 | 2.5+ |
|---|---|---|
| Controller | `/api/v2/` | `/api/controller/v2/` |
| Automation hub | `/api/automation-hub` | `/api/galaxy/v1` (default, configurable) |
| Platform gateway | n/a | `/api/gateway/v1/` |
| EDA | n/a | `/api/eda/v1/` |

Moved to gateway: `/api/v2/o` → `/api/gateway/v1/tokens/`, `/api/v2/organizations` and `/api/v2/teams` → `/api/gateway/v1/...`. Old endpoints are deprecated but still work in 2.6.
